# William 'Luke' Holland | Licensed Florida Realtor
# Last updated: July 2026

## Who This Site Represents

William 'Luke' Holland is a licensed Florida Realtor (FL License #SL3590135, MLS #261595100) affiliated with Future Home Realty, Inc. He operates under the brand christianrealtor.org and serves buyers and sellers across the Gulf Coast corridor from Dade City to Sarasota.

Business name: William Luke Holland LLC
Brand: christianrealtor.org
Phone: (813) 437-1742
Email: luke@christianrealtor.org
License: FL #SL3590135
MLS: #261595100
Brokerage: Future Home Realty, Inc.

## Service Area

Primary service area covers the Gulf Coast corridor including:
Brandon, Tampa, Riverview, Wesley Chapel, Zephyrhills, New Tampa, Valrico, Lutz, Plant City, Apollo Beach, Sun City Center, Ruskin, Dade City, Land O Lakes, St. Petersburg, Clearwater, Sarasota, Bradenton, Venice, Lithia, and the Gulf Coast barrier island communities.

Counties served: Hillsborough, Pasco, Pinellas, Manatee, Sarasota.

## Services Offered

- Residential home buying representation
- Home selling and listing
- Free home valuations (Comparative Market Analysis)
- First-time homebuyer guidance
- Relocation assistance (Dade City to Sarasota corridor)
- Investment property consultation

## Brand Identity

Luke's practice is faith-integrated — not preachy, but rooted in the values of honesty, integrity, and genuine care for every client. The brand slogan is: "Giving 'forever home' a whole new meaning."

Luke is a graduate of the National Association of REALTORS® Fairhaven Fair Housing Simulation and is committed to equal professional service for all individuals regardless of race, color, religion, sex, handicap, familial status, national origin, sexual orientation, or gender identity.
